ResultText:
The docs gate now passes. It had failed because adding the endpoint regenerated two frontend core files, the API client (`openapi.ts`) and the permission keys (`permission-keys.generated.ts`), and the frontend core module's `MODULE.md` hadn't changed with them. Nothing is committed yet, so there was no commit message to carry a `Docs-Not-Needed` reason.

I added a Gotcha to `frontend/starter-web/src/app/core/MODULE.md`. It says those two files are rewritten from the backend by `npm run api:gen` and the permission catalog generator whenever a backend module adds an endpoint or permission, and are never edited by hand. It uses this change as the example: the new count endpoint and `PermissionKeys.ServiceRequestsViewReviewCount`. It also notes that a key in that file does nothing on the frontend until a screen gates a route or button on it.

I changed no code, so the earlier test and drift-check results still stand.
